IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: Okta reports partial degradation in token verification API (introspect/jwks). We are seeing elevated 401s for interactive logins and some service token verifications. Root cause unknown. Paging OpsOnCall.

OpsOnCall: acknowledged, oncall here. Paging SRE. @Alex @Maya can you triage?

Alex (sre): on it. seeing spike in 401 rate from our frontend auth service (auth-proxy). sample log: `2026-03-15T09:02:11Z auth-proxy ERROR token_verification failed audience_mismatch 401`

Maya (eng): I'm checking JWKS fetches — our library returned HTTP 200 from okta but keys payload has fewer keys than expected, some kid values missing. Also seeing timeouts to okta-introspect endpoints ~30% 5xx.

Priya (support): customers reporting login failures for console and some API clients. Support ticket #4271 increasing. Customer impact: console logins blocked for ~40% of orgs in eu-west-1.

John (identity): Okta status page shows "partial disruption" for OIDC endpoints in EU. Confirmed by their incident feed. They say a rolling config push may have caused stale JWKS cache upstream.

Alex (sre): immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable local-JWKS cache fallback in auth-proxy (serve existing cached keys for +15m grace), 2) route console auth traffic to secondary identity tenant (internal fallback) for engineers, 3) open status page update. I'll apply 1 and 3 now.

Maya (eng): pushing config toggle to auth-proxy now (rollout canary -> 5% -> 100%). Command in deploy bot:```
kubectl set env deployment/auth-proxy AUTH_USE_CACHED_JWKS=true --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/auth-proxy -w --namespace=prod
```

OpsOnCall: @Alex please confirm canary health. Also coordinate handoff if this crosses the 30m on-call boundary.

Alex (sre): canary healthy at 5m. error rate dropped ~60% for token verification 401s on canary nodes. Rolling to 100% now.

Priya (support): I posted interim message to affected customers: "We're seeing third-party identity provider issues affecting logins; we've enabled a temporary fallback which should restore most console sign-ins. We'll update in 30 minutes." Customer responses getting calmer :thumbsup:.

John (identity): I opened Okta support case and linked our logs + jwks dump. They replied acknowledging the config push and are rolling a fix; ETA 20-40m. Good signal.

Maya (eng): After rollout, aggregate 401s dropped to baseline. However, we still see a small percentage of service-to-service token validation failures where tokens issued during the window have atypical `kid`. Plan: add secondary verification path: if jwks lookup fails, attempt introspection endpoint for that token. Implementing light-weight fallback now.

Alex (sre): go ahead but keep introspection calls rate-limited. Add circuit-breaker so we don't amplify Okta issues. Example pseudo:```
if (!verify_with_jwks(token)) {
  if (introspection_available && introspect_rate < 50/s) {
    call_introspection(token)
  } else {
    fail_fast()
  }
}
```

Priya (support): support runbook updated with repro steps and workaround. Added note: advise customers to retry login after ~2 minutes and try incognito if persistent.

OpsOnCall: 09:55 UTC handover check: I'm due to handoff in 25m, Alex will be primary, Maya secondary during my handoff. @Alex will you take post-incident page?

Alex (sre): I can own the postmortem and RCA. Will wait until Okta confirms fix and we observe stable metrics for 2h.

John (identity): Okta patch deployed at 10:12 UTC per their update. They cleared some stale key cache. Recommend we fetch fresh JWKS + rotate local cache immediately.

Maya (eng): fetched new JWKS and invalidated old cache at 10:15 UTC. Verified keys match Okta's live endpoint. Running validations across traffic — looks clean.

Priya (support): pushing final customer update: "Okta reports resolved, we enabled fallbacks and refreshed our key cache. Console login and API auth should be restored. If you still see issues, please contact support and include a timestamp."

OpsOnCall: closing incident channel to async updates. Postmortem action items to track: 1) add automated JWKS drift detection + alerting, 2) formalize introspection fallback with circuit-breaker, 3) update runbook with exact commands and customer messaging templates, 4) evaluate secondary IDP routing for critical admin logins. Assigning to Alex/Maya/John.

Alex (sre): noted. I'll file the postmortem doc and link to this thread. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
